title: Audit report
description: Output of one /kaizen:audit run. Wraps a list of findings plus the run-level summary (verdict, scope, counts). Mirrors the markdown template in onion-ddd-workflow Part 2 and boy-scout-rule's discovery-time application protocol.

run_id.description: Auto-generated at audit start: audit-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS (UTC). Matches workflow-state.schema.json id pattern style.

verdict.description: green = no P0/P1 findings. leaks = P1 findings only. violated = at least one P0. Maps to the onion-ddd-workflow audit verdict.

findings.description: All findings, in P0 → P3 severity order. Each item satisfies audit-finding.schema.json.

applied.description: Findings dispatched per audit Step 7 (apply in-flow).

trailed.description: Findings demoted to backlog/TODO with a named failing gate check.

recommended_next_step.description: What audit suggests as the next routine. ship-as-is = no P0/P1 + no in-scope cleanups remaining. plan-execute = invoke writing-plans/executing-plans for P0/P1 fixes. rerun-with-wider-scope = scope was too narrow to be useful.
